task.title: Validate Before Commit and Push
task.shortdesc: Catch problems early by validating files before you commit and push them.

context.p: The Git Client can run validation automatically at two points. Both checks are on by default and are configured on the Git Client preferences page.

step.cmd: To validate each file as you commit, keep Validate each file before committing selected.

info.p: If problems are found, the commit stops and the Git pre-commit validation tab of the Results area lists them. Select Allow commit despite validation problems to be able to Commit anyway.

step.cmd: To validate your project before you push, keep Validate all files from the project's "Main Files" folder before pushing selected.

info.p: This requires Main Files support, a configured validation scenario, and a matching project with no uncommitted changes (the Git Client offers to stash them otherwise). Problems appear in the Git pre-push validation tab, then select Allow push despite validation problems to be able to Push anyway.
info.note: Because this can stash your changes internally, pre-push validation is refused if the working copy has a filesystem name collision. See .
